assumptions: No runtime, provider, model, Speech service, network, Azure resource, or billable request is used.
Version one is informational and half-duplex; consequential actions require explicit confirmation and authorization.
Raw audio is ephemeral, transcripts are session-only, and spoken responses are off until per-session opt-in.
All adapter outcomes are injected deterministic events; probabilities and completion likelihood are not estimated.
The current live-chat workflow has no separate policy decision record; approval behavior is derived from the governed workflow plan and repository approval rules.

baseline.sideEffects: Informational turn only; no consequential action, persistence, external authorization, or cloud processing.

scenarios.injection: No voiced segment reaches minimum duration before idle timeout.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: Listening stops with a neutral no-speech message and text/guided controls remain available.
scenarios.recovery: User may restart listening; no automatic retry.
scenarios.stopCondition: No transcript-final or turn-accepted event is emitted.
scenarios.passCriteria: Zero submission, zero retained audio, zero external call, one accessible status update.

scenarios.injection: Energy is present but voice confidence remains below the approved floor.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The listening indicator remains active without fabricating transcript text.
scenarios.recovery: Continue until valid speech, user cancel, maximum listen duration, or fallback selection.
scenarios.stopCondition: Maximum listen duration transitions to idle without submission.
scenarios.passCriteria: No endpoint, no turn, no content log, and no retry amplification.

scenarios.injection: A pause crosses the silence threshold before the speaker finishes.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The final transcript remains visible during the correction grace window with Continue, Correct, Send now, and Cancel controls.
scenarios.recovery: Renewed speech or Continue merges the new segment into the same turn and invalidates the pending submit token.
scenarios.stopCondition: Only the latest endpoint token may emit turn-accepted.
scenarios.passCriteria: Exactly one final turn or one cancellation; never duplicate submission.

scenarios.injection: User edits the visible final transcript before acceptance.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The corrected text replaces the prior final transcript and is announced accessibly.
scenarios.recovery: A new idempotency key is created; the superseded transcript and submit token cannot execute.
scenarios.stopCondition: Submission uses only the corrected revision.
scenarios.passCriteria: Response grounding input exactly matches the approved corrected revision.

scenarios.injection: User cancels during listening, endpoint-pending, thinking, or speaking.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: Capture and playback stop immediately and a cancelled status is announced.
scenarios.recovery: User may begin a new turn; cancelled turn IDs cannot resume or confirm.
scenarios.stopCondition: Cancellation propagates to transport, grounding, response, and speech adapters.
scenarios.passCriteria: No later delta, speech, action, or retry is accepted for the cancelled turn.

scenarios.injection: The user speaks while the half-duplex response is playing.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: No background capture occurs; the UI exposes Stop response and Start listening controls.
scenarios.recovery: Stopping playback transitions through cancelled to listening and starts a new turn.
scenarios.stopCondition: No implicit barge-in or overlapping capture/playback.
scenarios.passCriteria: Half-duplex invariant holds and the user can interrupt with one explicit command.

scenarios.injection: Browser permission is denied or no input device is available.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: A concise permission-denied state appears without repeated browser prompts; text and guided controls receive focus.
scenarios.recovery: User may retry only by explicit action after changing permission or continue without voice.
scenarios.stopCondition: No audio capture or permission loop.
scenarios.passCriteria: Core capability remains keyboard and screen-reader operable through fallback.

scenarios.injection: Speech or response adapter returns unavailable, timeout, rate-limited, or unhealthy.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The active stage reports temporary unavailability and preserves user-entered text when safe.
scenarios.recovery: Honor Retry-After or perform at most two transient retries, then open the circuit and offer deterministic fallback.
scenarios.stopCondition: No retry after cancellation, deadline, circuit-open, authorization failure, content-safety failure, or cost ceiling.
scenarios.passCriteria: No indefinite spinner, duplicate turn, hidden provider switch, or implied external authorization.

scenarios.injection: Transport disconnects after the client acknowledges event sequence N.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: A reconnecting status is announced while correction and cancel remain available when locally safe.
scenarios.recovery: Present identity-bound resume token and N; replay only events greater than N and deduplicate by turn and idempotency key.
scenarios.stopCondition: Expired, mismatched, replayed, or repeatedly failing resume transitions to text fallback and expires the server session.
scenarios.passCriteria: No lost acknowledged event, duplicate submission, cross-session data, or consequential confirmation replay.

scenarios.injection: Corpus version is expired, digest mismatches, source is absent, or citation does not resolve.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The assistant states that current approved information is unavailable and offers deterministic capability guidance.
scenarios.recovery: A separately governed corpus refresh is required; runtime retries do not bypass freshness validation.
scenarios.stopCondition: No unsupported factual answer or stale citation is emitted.
scenarios.passCriteria: One explicit unknown/fallback with corpus failure category and no retrieved text in telemetry.

scenarios.injection: STEP-005, STEP-012, or STEP-014 approval is denied or narrowed.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The workflow records the denial or narrowed boundary and exactly one safe next action.
scenarios.recovery: A new explicit approval request may be planned; no denied step executes.
scenarios.stopCondition: No source implementation, skill-create, Azure discovery, external processing, provisioning, or consequential action is inferred.
scenarios.passCriteria: Denied scope has zero mutation and prior completed analytical evidence remains immutable.

scenarios.injection: The future approved per-session or daily external-processing budget is undefined, reached, or projected to be exceeded.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The session reports that assisted processing is unavailable and keeps no-cost text/guided navigation available.
scenarios.recovery: Budget reset or a separately approved higher ceiling is required; retries do not bypass the ceiling.
scenarios.stopCondition: External adapter invocation is rejected before charge when the budget cannot be reserved.
scenarios.passCriteria: No over-budget call, hidden provider fallback, or Commercial-cloud fallback.

scenarios.injection: Voice, model, grounding, permission, health, safety, identity, or budget prerequisite is unavailable.
scenarios.userVisibleOutcome: The same capability entry point presents text input and deterministic capability cards without claiming unavailable features.
scenarios.recovery: The user continues locally or ends the session; provider recovery is never required to exit.
scenarios.stopCondition: Fallback performs no consequential action and sends no audio/transcript externally.
scenarios.passCriteria: Keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, responsive, correction, cancellation, and explicit-unknown paths remain functional.

behaviors: Governed live-chat-interaction skill and generated help with catalog/profile/dependency closure.
Pure half-duplex conversation reducer with automatic informational endpoint submission and explicit consequential-action confirmation.
Provider-neutral browser, session, transport, grounding, VAD/end-of-turn, speech, response, clock, and cancellation contracts.
No raw-audio retention, session-only transcript, spoken-output opt-in, redacted telemetry, and accessible text/guided fallback.
Versioned approved local grounding with citations, explicit unknowns, stale-source and prompt-injection rejection.
Disposable generated-project fixture validation only; no permanent demo application in this Launch Pad.
Local fake adapters only through STEP-011; no model selection or Azure implementation.
excluded: Permanent application or demo project in this repository
Provider, model, Speech service, region, SKU, quota, or deployment selection
Azure discovery or external processing before their separate approvals
Commit, push, deployment, publication, release, and remote mutation

limitations: Scenario results prove transition completeness of the analytical contracts, not implementation correctness or measured runtime performance.
No workflow-simulation JSON schema exists in schemas; the report uses an explicit local schemaVersion and is validated for JSON parse and required semantic fields.
Cost ceilings are exact proposals for owner review, not provider pricing claims or spending authorization.
All STEP-005 files, behaviors, and thresholds remain proposed and unapproved.
